title: The abbey has no bells
style_prompt: cinematic horror film still, dark, moody, low key lighting, 35mm film grain, desaturated, realistic, rainy British city at night, no text, no watermark
hook_text: Bells rang from the ruins. The abbey has no bells.

scenes.narration: Bells rang from the abbey ruins.

shots.prompt: stone shepherd's hut on a foggy moor at dusk, ruined abbey arches in the distance, no person visible

scenes.narration: I was bringing the flock down before the snow. The abbey has been a ruin for centuries. It has no bells. My sheep stopped dead.

shots.prompt: flock of sheep standing still on a misty moor at dusk, ruined stone arches behind

scenes.narration: Through the fog, tall pale shapes stood among them. Slowly, they copied how I walked. Every step. A second late. Like they were learning me.

shots.prompt: tall pale blurred silhouettes in dense fog on a moor, backs turned, no faces

scenes.narration: I ran to the stone hut and bolted the door. Then came the scratching. And my wife's voice. Please. It's cold. Let us in. I know that voice. I have heard it every night since.

shots.prompt: heavy wooden door of a stone hut at night, thin firelight beneath it

scenes.narration: My wife went missing in spring. My son, too. My boy giggled. Dad, please. We've been out here so long. Please, Dad. It hurts to wait.

shots.prompt: dark stone hut interior with a dying fire, shadows on the wall

scenes.narration: I reached for the bolt. Then the voices stopped. And a third voice spoke. Calm. Tired. Mine. Let me in. It's freezing out here. And the bolt began to slide on its own.

shots.prompt: hand hovering over a rusty door bolt in the dark, no face

scenes.narration: So tell me. Open the door, or wait for dawn?

shots.prompt: stone shepherd's hut on a foggy moor at dusk, ruined abbey arches in the distance, no person visible
